transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

I guess... my eating's just been off lately. Some days I only manage coffee and maybe a granola bar before my shift. My scrubs are hanging pretty loose now. I haven't been trying to lose weight or anything. It's just... happening.
Have you noticed yourself avoiding certain foods or eating less because you're worried about gaining weight?
No... it's not about that. I just don't have the appetite. I'm not worried about my weight.
Have you been feeling down or losing interest in things you usually enjoy, like work or time with friends?
I don't know... I guess so. Most mornings I just wake up with this... heavy feeling. It's kind of hollow. Like the day is just already ruined before I even put on my badge for work.
Have you found that things you used to enjoy, like hobbies or spending time with friends, just don’t feel the same anymore? Like you don’t get any pleasure from them?

Yeah, I guess. I used to go running in Van Cortlandt Park... take some photos. Sometimes I'd play chess with a couple of guys. But lately... I just don't see the point. I mostly just sit at home now. Scroll on my phone... or just look at my budget spreadsheet. It's just... whatever.
Have you been feeling down or depressed most days, even when there's no clear reason for it?
Yeah... pretty much. It's not just a bad week or something. It's... most days. For a long time now, really. Just that same... heavy feeling. It doesn't go away.
Have you noticed that you feel more tired than usual, even when you haven't done much? Or like you don't have the energy to do even simple things?

Yeah, I guess. I mean... even if I sleep all night, I just... I wake up and my body feels like I just finished a double shift at the hospital. It's hard to explain. By lunchtime, I'm just... fighting to keep my thoughts together. It's just exhausting.
Have you lost a significant amount of weight recently without trying, or noticed a decrease in your appetite?

Yeah... I suppose. My eating has just been... off, I guess. Some days I barely get down coffee and a granola bar before my shift. And... yeah, my scrubs are hanging pretty loose lately. I'm not trying to lose weight or anything. I just... don't really have the appetite.
Have you been feeling like you're not worth much or that you're failing others, even when there's no real reason to think that?

I don't know... I guess so. I just... I feel like I'm dragging everyone down. At the clinic, at home... I just feel like a burden. If I'm a little slow turning over a room, I just... I feel like I ruined the whole schedule for the day. Like it's all my fault.
Have you noticed that your thoughts feel slower than usual or that your body feels like it's moving in slow motion?

I don't know... maybe. Sometimes at work, I just... I end up pacing around the supply area, checking the same drawers over and over. Or... I don't know, I just move really slow. Doing simple things, like drawing up labels or answering a patient... it just takes me twice as long as it should. I don't really know why.
